parallel.note: the probe failed 3 of 3 times; one hand-run of the identical prompt and canary files passed (both seats ran, started 2 s apart and overlapped by about 8 s). Seats need a shell tool: a subagent has no tools unless it declares them (`tools: [run_command]`, now in the probe's agy canary), and headless `agy -p` soft-denies a `RunCommand` unless a `command(...)` allow rule in agy's own settings.json matches the command text EXACTLY (`command(date)` matched `date` but not `date +%s`). With exact rules for `date +%s` and `sleep 8` in place (since rolled back) one seat ran `date +%s`, yet the full probe still failed on every run: any rewording of a command is denied and ends the turn (agy log: "Print mode: soft-denying tool confirmation RunCommand"). Not reliable without `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, which was not used
